news.title: £500m Sovereign AI Fund visits Belfast as NI AI sector doubles
news.blurb: Selected NI AI companies pitched to the team behind the £500m UK Sovereign AI Fund at a launch event at Catalyst on 8 October. The AICC's 2026 census, cited at the event, found the number of commercially engaged NI AI firms rose from 198 to 400 in a year.

news.title: ARC Regulatory wins £3.7m in pharma lab projects
news.blurb: Belfast's ARC Regulatory has won more than £3.7m of new laboratory projects from global pharma companies to support precision-medicine programmes. The work runs through its in-house ARC Laboratories, which has added new testing workflows.

news.title: CATAGEN signs North American alliance with Roush
news.blurb: CATAGEN has formed a multi-year strategic alliance with Roush Industries, which will install CATAGEN's OMEGA Reactors at its Michigan facility. Roush will offer the engine-free emissions testing services to US automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.

news.title: Kainos launches AI product business Actonomy
news.blurb: Kainos has launched Actonomy, a new business focused on getting AI into production for enterprises, led by CEO Ruth McGuinness. Kainos says it can cut the time to get AI into production by up to 75%.

news.title: REA Group buys 35% of PropertyPal parent Distilled
news.blurb: Australia's REA Group, majority-controlled by News Corp, is taking a 35% stake worth €248m in Distilled, the Daft.ie and DoneDeal owner that also owns Belfast-based PropertyPal and Used Cars NI. REA expects the deal to complete by the end of 2026.

news.title: Report ranks NI first in UK for scaling businesses
news.blurb: Ulster Bank and NatWest's 'From Innovation to Impact' report ranks Northern Ireland first among the UK regions it analysed for its share of scaling businesses. It says grant-backed NI businesses have drawn over £629m in follow-on investment.

news.title: Respiratory Analytics raises £1.2m for aflo asthma platform
news.blurb: North-west healthtech Respiratory Analytics secured £1.2m in pre-seed equity and grant funding, led by Angel Academe EIS Fund I with SyndicateRoom, QUBIS and angel investors. The funds will go towards FDA clearance, more clinical studies and first commercial asthma markets for its aflo inhaler-technique platform.

news.title: Whitespace Global to double NI workforce with 40 jobs
news.blurb: Belfast defence AI company Whitespace Global plans 40 new roles over three years, with an average salary of £78,500, backed by Invest NI. The company cited its Series A funding as part of the basis for growth.
